scope: Actual successful and failed-prefix PL input scheduling witnesses
Known short-write stop and known-versus-unknown byte accounting

source_review_results.evidence: evaluate_input appends its witness only inside the actually invoked callback, captures interval/substep/count/numerator/stage and returned power, then captures used power after dispatch returns. The substep variable k is bound in field defaults. The successful return packs indices/returned_power/used_power; the exception partial retains the actual list, including attempted-but-not-returned entries and no invented future entries. Constant input produces an empty witness. No new input_eval or RHS callback was added.
source_review_results.test_source_inspected: test_input_consistency_kernel.py checks the actual successful schedule and returned/used inputs; existing callback-failure tests were read. The final combined runtime receipt is still pending.

source_review_results.evidence: The measured writer records the actual returned count, sets known_return, then raises on returned bytes differing from requested bytes. The failure permanently poisons OutputIO. Known short returns do not increment unknown byte/operation counts. Normal EOF reads retain their separate behavior. The journal exit synchronizes and closes its own stream in a finally-protected cleanup path.
source_review_results.test_source_inspected: The new text/binary short-write tests assert stop, preserved actual bytes and zero unknown-byte increments. The final combined runtime receipt is still pending.

source_review_results.evidence: SealLedger reserves each finite action, measures returned read/write prefixes, records failures and durability uncertainty, rejects retries after poison and returns deep snapshots. Reads validate both byte totals and before/after file sizes; known early EOF is not counted as an unknown read. Controller stores the N+1 preceding hash/line-count actions in output_io_summary, returns the final four actions through the external shared-budget receipt, and attaches ledger snapshot plus phase to failures. error_record retains both fields. Cleanup failures are recorded without replacing the original scientific/seal error when fatal evidence saving succeeds.
source_review_results.durability_boundary: The ledger is in memory until the caller saves its snapshot. Process interruption before that save remains unknown/spent. The final four success actions are not self-certified inside the run; their external completion receipt still needs its separate review.
source_review_results.bound_component_result: Nine SealLedger synthetic tests and Ruff/check-format pass under the exact source/test hashes recorded below. The new controller integration suite is still pending.

source_review_results.evidence: ScopeStore.execute checks poisoned/closed journal state before entering the routine that increments ordinal. If begin fails before active is assigned, fatal_prefix retains attempted_scope_without_closed_record from the last reserved schedule position; unvisited_scopes starts after that spent attempt. Existing active-but-unclosed scopes remain separately identified.
